steps.title: Prologue
steps.text: Lucia is in prison, discussing early release. Jason lives in the Leonida Keys.

steps.title: Gone Fishing
steps.text: A smuggling run goes wrong and Jason rescues Donnie from the Kingfishers. Lucia says she is getting out early.

steps.title: Jobs for Brian
steps.text: Jason collects rent and runs jobs with Cal for Brian Heder.

steps.title: Island Dreams
steps.text: Jason finds treasure on a dive and agrees to work with Kenton.

steps.title: Coming Home
steps.text: Lucia is released. At the Rusty Anchor they meet Kat and her boyfriend Mattia.

steps.title: Day Release
steps.text: Mattia gets Lucia's ankle tag removed and offers a well-paid job: fetching a bag.

steps.title: Swamped
steps.text: The sit-down with the Kingfishers is a setup. Donnie dies and Brian quits smuggling.

steps.title: Tourist Trap
steps.text: Disguised as Mattia and Kat, the pair grab the bag. Dirty cops attack and Jason is badly hurt.

steps.title: Discharge Time
steps.text: Masked men burn the house. The pair fight out of the hospital and flee west.

steps.title: What's in the Bag?
steps.text: A Port Gellhorn motel. Captain Mendez blames them on the news. The bag holds a statue and a hard drive.

steps.title: Girls' Trip & Slam Dunk
steps.text: Lucia meets dancer Vicki and dealer Dunk and gets painkillers for Jason.

steps.title: Moses
steps.text: Mechanic Moses Watkins buys the cars Lucia steals.

steps.title: Robbery spree
steps.text: The pair rob their way across rural Leonida and hit Delights Cabaret with Vicki. The goal: Vice City and Dre'Quan.

steps.title: Checking Out
steps.text: The masked men find the motel. The pair escape to Vice City.

steps.title: Welcome to Vice City
steps.text: Dre'Quan welcomes them. His boss Boobie Ike lends them an apartment.

steps.title: Dealer's Choice
steps.text: As a favor to Boobie, Jason does a drug deal with Dre'Quan, picking up the product from Tyrone. Cal fails to crack the hard drive.

steps.title: Meet the Heders
steps.text: Brian and Lori put the pair in touch with Raul. Lucia's test car theft turns up a severed head in the trunk.

steps.title: Dubious Provenance
steps.text: An antique dealer thinks the statue is fake or stolen. Appraiser Benedict Halifax takes it, leaving his watch as a pledge.

steps.title: Mami Knows Best
steps.text: Lucia's mother Mia starts flipping houses. The M7 gang next door kidnaps them, and Lucia helps boss Terro beat his rival Viper.

steps.title: Kitty Litter
steps.text: Tyrone wants a cut of a new synthetic drug sweeping the city, then decides it must go and sends the pair to wreck the labs.

steps.title: Car Service
steps.text: Another test from Raul: Lucia lifts a car and delivers it to Randy Kozlov, a fence for upscale vehicles.

steps.title: Top Billing
steps.text: Dre'Quan's act The Real Dimez get their stage stolen by rival rapper DWNPLY. Roxy storms off, then makes up with the group.

steps.title: Boobie Time
steps.text: Jason chauffeurs Boobie on his collection rounds and meets Yasmani, a Little Cuba buyer of stolen goods.

steps.title: First Impressions
steps.text: The pair finally meet Raul face to face and learn their getaway was cover for a bigger bank robbery.

steps.title: Caught Slipping
steps.text: Burglars hit the apartment but the hard drive survives. The bag is moved into a rented storage unit.

steps.title: Crosstown Traffic
steps.text: For Raul, the pair hijack a Guardia Brothers boat shipment, are exposed, and outrun both the gang and the Coast Guard.

steps.title: Credit Check
steps.text: At Raul's base they meet his crew, driver Felipe, techie Karim and disguise expert Andrea, and practise on small banks.

steps.title: Steal the Zorrusso
steps.text: Randy hands over a key cloner so the pair can take a luxury car in Ocean Beach.

steps.title: Sinfrontera National Bank
steps.text: Raul's real target is a bank washing money for the La Polilla Negra cartel. The pair spring security expert Nicole Park from cartel guards.

steps.title: Ride or Die
steps.text: To help Dre'Quan get even with DWNPLY, Jason steals the rapper's car and escapes his bodyguard and the Cash City gang.

steps.title: Company Property
steps.text: Brian sets up a weapons drop from smuggler Pilot Pete for Raul's job, but the IAA and police crash the unloading.

steps.title: The Missing Link
steps.text: Andrea and Lucia snatch cartel enforcer Monty after a cockfight. The crew dangles him over alligators to make him talk.

steps.title: Safe Word
steps.text: So Lucia can practise for the vault, the pair steal a smaller copy of the bank's safe from a mansion and haul it across town.

steps.title: Cooties
steps.text: Lucia helps shoot a Dimez music video that smashes DWNPLY's car and makes a fool of him.

steps.title: Bricked Up
steps.text: Boobie wants payback for the apartment. A cocaine pickup is raided by Mendez's crooked cops, so the pair decide to move out.

steps.title: Hidden Charges
steps.text: They rig cell towers with explosives to blind the police and the bank. Raul agrees to help with the hard drive afterwards.

steps.title: The Cartel Heist
steps.text: Raul's crew robs Sinfrontera National Bank. Raul promises an advance and a suite at the Y Hotel.

steps.title: Ocean Beach
steps.text: Raul's money-launderer Valentina moves them into a luxury hotel suite and supplies new cars. Lucia relives her last morning before prison.

steps.title: Lawyer Up
steps.text: Lawyer Abe Gonzalez will help them for a favor. He hints Lucia could save herself by turning on Jason, and she says no.

steps.title: Party Hard
steps.text: Guarding soap star Andres de Leon at the Megamundo launch, the pair stop FAP rebels holding guests hostage, including the Navarros.

steps.title: Heavy Lifting
steps.text: The drive goes to Raul, who plans to rob rival bodybuilder Kordell Grant's crew. Karim traces the drive to shipping heir Giorgio Gallo.

steps.title: Photo/Shoot
steps.text: Cash City grab Dre'Quan during a rooftop shoot. The pair and the Dimez get him back, and he is promised a meeting with Royce Jones.

steps.title: Making Gainz
steps.text: Lucia trains with bodybuilder Nate to get close to Kordell's crew and into the gym's private floor.

steps.title: Watch It
steps.text: Club owner Royce Jones says his VYB club stays shut until blackmail from rap star Dante Fresh is dealt with.

steps.title: Winning Over the Crew
steps.text: Lucia sells gym drugs with Nate and helps Cisco with a debt, while a photo trap is used to sour Kordell's crew on Raina.

steps.title: Too Much Baggage
steps.text: Jason takes a job as an airport baggage handler under Omar and plants bugs so Karim can tap airport security.

steps.title: Adventures in Babysitting
steps.text: Jason protects Andres at a nightclub from a FAP kidnap attempt, then they find his son Rafa has been taken.

steps.title: Fresh Evidence
steps.text: Jason and Dre'Quan break into Dante Fresh's mansion and steal the blackmail on Royce, earning the Dimez the VYB reopening.

steps.title: Power Play
steps.text: Lucia rides along on Kordell's armored car job while Jason learns the airport vault plan. Raul decides to let Kordell do the work, then take the score.

steps.title: Child's Play
steps.text: The pair free Rafa from FAP near a quarry. Navarro security chief Gustavo is exposed as a traitor, and Abe sorts out new identities.

steps.title: Headliners
steps.text: DWNPLY's goons take the Dimez hostage at VYB's reopening. The pair save them, and Dre'Quan announces a tour.

steps.title: Close Surveillance
steps.text: With a drone, Jason and Karim lean on baggage boss Omar for airport access. The drive turns out to hold footage of Senator Camila Fuentes.

steps.title: Team Building
steps.text: Jason hacks airport security to plant Lucia's fake credentials. Kordell grows suspicious of Lucia, but her cover survives a tense meeting with Raul.

steps.title: Fully Catered
steps.text: The pair steal an airport catering truck and pack bags with fake money. Raul opens up to Jason about his son.

steps.title: VCIA Takedown
steps.text: The airport vault job. Raul's crew turns on Kordell's, Lucia and Raul put a jet down in the bay, and Raul plans to sell the drive.

steps.title: Sunset
steps.text: After weeks of quiet, a note leads them to Raul's houseboat. He has been tortured after Valentina sold him out, and dies there.

steps.title: Starting From Zero
steps.text: Hunted and broke, they collect the drive from Andrea and the statue from storage. Mattia leads them to Giorgio Gallo, the bag's real owner.

steps.title: Bird in the Hand
steps.text: Giorgio admits using the drive to blackmail Senator Fuentes. With Navy specialists Vinny, Kevin and Liz they steal a military helicopter.

steps.title: Taking Liberties
steps.text: Giorgio dangles a presidential pardon. An Albanian hitman gives him one last chance: sink a rival cocaine shipment.

steps.title: VC Baby
steps.text: Kat goes into labor at Giorgio's penthouse and Mattia begs the pair for help.

steps.title: Doggie Bag
steps.text: Vinny and Lucia steal Rocco, the Coast Guard's best drug dog, to sniff out the rival shipment.

steps.title: Operation Savage Glory
steps.text: They blow up the rival ship and pull the seized cocaine out of Coast Guard hands. Vinny and Liz are killed.

steps.title: Protective Custody
steps.text: Giorgio double-crosses them and they are arrested separately. Prosecutor Danica Howard says only the drive can free them. Mendez's men close in.

steps.title: The End of the Road
steps.text: The final assault on Giorgio's penthouse to grab the drive, then a desperate run for freedom. The ending depends on your choices.
